name: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

angles.text: The Gnarlpine were once peaceful neighbors and allies to the Kaldorei. Their corruption now threatens Teldrassil.
The Sentinels call on Alliance adventurers to secure the night elf homeland from corruption by clearing dangerous furbolg encampments across the boughs.
As a druid, you see how the Gnarlpine have lost their harmony with nature. Their hostility now endangers the balance of the glade you are sworn to preserve.

faq.answer: Shayla Nightbreeze offers the bounty from the road outside Darnassus, Teldrassil’s capital.
faq.q: Who offers the bounty on the Gnarlpine furbolg?

faq.answer: Corruption has stripped the Gnarlpine of reason and made them aggressive threats to travelers, night elf settlements, and Teldrassil’s natural wildlife.
faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolg being hunted?

faq.answer: The Gnarlpine gather in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the main path, and in Starbreeze Village farther east.
faq.q: Where can the Gnarlpine furbolg be found?

faq.answer: Shayla Nightbreeze requires Gnarlpine fangs as physical proof that the furbolg threats have been removed from the boughs of the World Tree.
faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?

faq.answer: The Sentinels authorized the bounty through direct orders to secure Teldrassil’s boughs. They are the night elves’ military protectors.
faq.q: Who authorized the bounty on the Gnarlpine?

aliases: did furbolg used to be friendly
faq.answer: Furbolgs once allied with the night elves and lived peacefully beside them. Corruption has twisted their minds and broken that peace.
faq.q: Were the Gnarlpine always hostile to the night elves?

sections.body: Outside Darnassus, Shayla Nightbreeze carries the Sentinels’ orders to place a bounty on the Gnarlpine furbolg. They once lived peacefully in the ancient forests. Now corruption has stripped away their reason and made them vicious threats to travelers and Teldrassil’s natural sanctity.
sections.title: A Decree from the Sentinels

sections.body: Hunters cull the Gnarlpine across the boughs of the World Tree and collect their fangs as proof. Ban'ethil Hollow lies south of the road west of Dolanaar, and it is one of their two major strongholds. The other is the ruined Starbreeze Village to the east.
sections.title: Purging the Encampments

summary: Outside Darnassus, the Alliance bounty on Gnarlpine furbolg remains in force. Corruption spreads through Teldrassil, and Shayla Nightbreeze asks hunters to bring back the beasts’ fangs.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg
